summary: 回收原料必须区分制造废料、质保/召回废料和退役动力/储能电池，三者产生时间、成分稳定性和采购价格完全不同。
why_search_may_miss_it: 媒体常用‘废旧电池’总称，不区分制造端和终端退役端。

recalled_details.gap_reason: first pass distinguished manufacturing scrap vs EOL broadly, but recall/warranty streams were not formalized
recalled_details.schema_implication: recycling feedstock requires origin_type and generation_event

suggested_queries: 电池回收 制造废料 退役 召回 区别
battery recycling production scrap warranty recall end of life
disconfirmation_queries: all battery recycling feedstock economically equivalent

summary: 黑粉/废料采购可能按其中锂镍钴等金属价值的计价系数、折扣和冶炼回收率结算，不能用单一元/吨价格比较。
why_search_may_miss_it: 交易条款高度非标准，媒体只报道金属价或废料价。

recalled_details.gap_reason: first pass covered black-mass pricing generally but not payable/metal-basket mechanics
recalled_details.schema_implication: recycling feedstock price needs metal assays + payable formula + reference price

suggested_queries: 黑粉 计价系数 锂 镍 钴 回收 折扣
black mass payable lithium nickel cobalt pricing formula
disconfirmation_queries: black mass trades at uniform fixed RMB per tonne

summary: 三元和LFP回收经济性不同：三元的镍钴价值长期提高废料价值，而LFP更依赖锂回收率、规模和工艺成本，高LFP占比会改变整个回收行业利润模型。
why_search_may_miss_it: 很多回收产能按万吨统一统计，忽略来料化学体系。

recalled_details.gap_reason: first pass noted LFP economics but did not define chemistry-specific feedstock economics as a core dimension
recalled_details.schema_implication: recycling economics needs feedstock_chemistry and recovered-metal basket

suggested_queries: LFP 三元 回收 经济性 锂 镍 钴
LFP NCM recycling economics lithium recovery
disconfirmation_queries: LFP and NCM recycling margins structurally identical
disconfirmation_source_types: 分化学体系毛利/回收率

summary: 头部电池厂与回收企业通过闭环合作、股权和废料定向供应建立 captive recycling loops，社会废料市场可获得原料量可能小于总废料产生量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 回收统计看总废料，合同决定其中多少进入公开市场。

recalled_details.gap_reason: offtake network existed, but captive recycling loop effect on merchant feedstock was not explicit

suggested_queries: 电池 回收 闭环 废料 定向 供应 合作
battery closed loop recycling scrap offtake agreement
disconfirmation_queries: all battery scrap available to open recycling market

summary: 中国动力电池回收白名单、溯源和生产者责任制度的历次政策会影响正规/非正规渠道竞争，但政策名单不等于企业实际回收量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 后期名单更新会覆盖早期入选/退出情况，且名单资格与实际产能/采购量不同。

recalled_details.gap_reason: policy existed as broad recycling context, but whitelist vintage vs realized activity was not explicit

suggested_queries: 动力电池 回收 白名单 批次 工信部 2019 2021
China battery recycling whitelist traceability policy
disconfirmation_queries: recycling whitelist membership equals actual recycling volume

summary: 早期对2025年前后退役动力电池规模的预测普遍较乐观，但电池寿命、车辆淘汰周期、出口二手车和梯次利用会改变真实报废时间。
why_search_may_miss_it: 最新回收量会覆盖旧预测，且预测常用固定寿命假设。

recalled_details.gap_reason: retirement forecasts were known generally, but delay mechanisms need explicit expectation-vs-outcome tracking

suggested_queries: 2020 2025 动力电池 退役量 预测
disconfirmation_queries: early battery retirement forecasts matched actual retirement timing

summary: 梯次利用曾被视为退役动力电池的重要去向，但安全、一致性、检测分选成本和新电池降价可能削弱其经济性，实际规模应与早期期待分开。
why_search_may_miss_it: 技术/示范项目新闻很多，规模商业化和安全监管数据少。

recalled_details.gap_reason: second-life satellite existed, but economic disconfirmation channels were not explicit

suggested_queries: 梯次利用 动力电池 经济性 安全 2021 2022
battery second life economics safety China
disconfirmation_queries: second-life batteries captured most retired EV batteries as forecast

summary: 高金属价格阶段大量回收产能规划可能在后续因原料不足、价格下跌或竞争加剧低开工，设计万吨处理能力不应视作实际二次资源供给。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公告统计设计处理量，实际来料和开工率很少按项目公开。

recalled_details.gap_reason: first pass noted capacity expansion but not project-level stranded recycling capacity

battery recycling capacity low utilization feedstock shortage China
